title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
Description BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.  This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.    The Opportunity  We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.  You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.  This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.   What You'll Own Email & Retention Design   Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue  Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action  Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms   Web Creative & CRO Support   Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores  Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste  Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs   Social & Ad Creative   Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels  Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing  Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed   Process & Quality   Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear  Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)  Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients  Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines  Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines  Who You Are Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:   An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself  Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good  Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does  A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased  Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball  AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter  Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.  What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days:   You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts  You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds  You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files  You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production  Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests  
 Must-Have:   2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)  A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results  Advanced proficiency in Figma  Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)  Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow  Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)  Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices  Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands  Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team   Strong Differentiators:   Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)  Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms  Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built  Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data  Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)  Agency background preferred  
 This role is fully remote.  Time Commitment and Availability   Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow  Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST   Compensation  $20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate. title: Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do. 
 Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplinesâresearch, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Youâll own three core responsibilities: 
 
  Coordination . Youâll manage cross-functional teams of 5â10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea â build â launch â analysis. Youâll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. 
  Strategy & Planning.  Youâll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10â20 upcoming experiments. Youâll communicate the âwhyâ behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings. 
  Energy (âVibesâ).  Youâre the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated. 
 
 Skills, Knowledge and Traits 
 You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Hereâs what we need from you: 
 
  Organization and diligence.  You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and donât stop until things are finished properly. 
  Communication.  You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it. 
  Smart and high agency.  You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or donât. Youâre the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions. 
 
 What Youâll Get 
 
  Clear promotion opportunities.  We invest heavily in training and promote almost exclusively from within. Most leaders at Spiralyze started in entry-level roles. 
  Tech reimbursement.  Need a better computer, monitor, or setup? Want training on Figma or GA4? Weâll help. 
  In-demand skills.  Youâll learn Conversion Rate Optimization from the most experienced experimentation teams in the world. 
  Time to recharge.  20 days of paid vacation plus holidays. 
 
 If youâre excited about working with smart people, solving real problems, and growing fast in a merit-based environment, weâd love to hear from you. title: Accounting and Implementation Manager
description:
Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything.  Aprio has 40 U.S. office locations, as well as international office locations and more than 3,200 team members that speak 60+ languages across the globe.   By bringing together proven expertise, deep understanding, and strategic foresight for fast-growing industries, Aprio ensures clients are prepared for wherever life or business may take them. Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio.     
  
  Aprio is seeking an  Aprio is seeking an  Accounting and Implementation Manager    to lead  restaurant, franchise, and hospitality  platform implementations, re-implementations, and optimization initiatives that connect accounting, operations, and technology. In this role, you will partner with clients and our accounting team to translate complex accounting and operational needs into practical configurations, integrations, workflows, controls, reporting structures, and training across platforms including Restaurant365 (R365), QuickBooks Online (QBO), Sage Intacct, and other industry-specific tools. You will serve as a trusted technology resource across the practice â driving implementation quality, enabling team capability, and building a repeatable, scalable delivery model. This is a high-impact opportunity for a systems-minded professional who brings both accounting fluency and a practical approach to helping people get the most from their technology. 
  
  \n      What You'll Gain/ Impact  
 Clients will have platform environments that support reliable accounting, disciplined operations, strong controls, and sustainable growth 
 Our accounting team will have the tools, training, documentation, and responsive support needed to serve clients efficiently across multiple platforms 
 Implementations will move forward with clear ownership, clean master data, disciplined testing, timely decisions, and fewer surprises 
 Your improvements will reduce manual work, strengthen operating data, and build a repeatable, high-value delivery capability across the practice 
 
       Key Responsibilities   Platform Implementation & Re-Implementation  
 
 Lead implementations and re-implementations across restaurant, franchise, and hospitality platforms â including R365, QBO, Sage Intacct, and other industry-specific tools â from discovery and design through configuration, testing, cutover, and stabilization 
 Partner with clients and our accounting team to translate accounting and operational needs into practical plans, system designs, and success criteria 
 Configure and validate entities, locations, calendars, chart of accounts, reporting, user roles, approvals, banking, daily sales, AP, payroll, and inventory workflows 
 Guide data readiness, testing, decisions, and go-live activities while helping the accounting team resolve issues that affect service delivery, close, and reporting 
 
 
  Client Accounting & Financial Reporting  
 
 Own accounting and financial reporting for assigned clients, including agreed-upon deliverables, deadlines, responsibilities, and scope. 
 Lead month-end and year-end close, using technology and automation where appropriate to improve consistency, identify exceptions, and accelerate routine work. 
 Prepare and review complete, accurate, and well-supported workpapers that clearly document account activity, reconciliations, conclusions, and the audit trail supporting financial reporting. 
 
 
  Restaurant Operations Configuration  
 
 Build and govern inventory items, categories, locations, count practices, costing methods, and location availability 
 Review and map vendor items; configure units of measure, pack sizes, conversions, and yields to support accurate purchasing, invoicing, and inventory valuation 
 Build recipes, sub-recipes, menu items, and theoretical costs; map POS and PMIX data to recipes and resolve exceptions affecting usage and margin reporting 
 Configure labor scheduling, job codes, forecasting inputs, and targets; establish best-practice routines for counts, waste, transfers, receiving, recipe maintenance, and exception review 
 
  Platform Optimization & Process Design  
 
 Evaluate platform environments â including R365, QBO, Sage Intacct, and other tools â alongside accounting and operations teams to identify configuration gaps, workarounds, control weaknesses, and improvement opportunities 
 Simplify and standardize workflows, templates, naming conventions, approvals, dashboards, and recurring processes across entities and locations 
 Prioritize improvements based on impact, effort, risk, and readiness, then help teams adopt sustainable platform governance 
 
  Integrations, Data & Reporting  
 
 Coordinate POS, banking, invoice capture, payments, payroll, sales, inventory, and other integrations across applicable platforms 
 Lead mapping, migration, validation, exception resolution, and testing so the accounting team can rely on complete, accurate data 
 Build reporting structures, dashboards, and role-based access that help accounting teams deliver timely, decision-ready information to clients 
 
  Training, Adoption & Knowledge Enablement  
 
 Develop and deliver role-based training for our accounting team, client administrators, and accounting, AP, banking, sales, inventory, purchasing, recipe, labor, payroll, and close users across applicable platforms 
 Coach users on best practices for counts, item and unit-of-measure governance, recipes, POS/PMIX exceptions, labor scheduling, and data-quality reviews 
 Create clear documentation, job aids, workflows, controls, governance standards, and troubleshooting guidance the accounting team can use in daily client service 
 Provide post-go-live support, address recurring pain points, and recommend targeted training or system improvements 
 
       Candidate Qualifications   Required:  
 
  Experience supporting restaurant, franchise, hospitality, multi-entity, or multi-location businesses  
  Background in outsourced accounting, CAS, public accounting, or another multi-client professional-services environment  
  Experience improving accounting, reporting, analytics, or client-service workflows through technology or automation   
 Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, Hospitality Management, Project Management, or a related field 
 Five or more years of ERP implementation, accounting technology, restaurant systems or operations, systems consulting, or related professional-services experience 
 Hands-on experience with Restaurant365 (R365), QuickBooks Online (QBO), Sage Intacct, or comparable restaurant, franchise, or hospitality platform implementation, administration, optimization, or support 
 Working knowledge of close, reporting, banking, daily sales, AP, inventory, purchasing, item mapping, units of measure, recipes, POS/PMIX, payroll, labor scheduling, and controls 
 Strong client-facing project leadership, facilitation, documentation, problem-solving, change-management, and communication skills 
 
  Preferred:  
 
 R365 certification, Sage Intacct certification, or advanced experience across accounting and operations modules 
 Restaurant, franchise, hospitality, multi-entity, or multi-location experience, including POS/PMIX, inventory, recipe costing, labor, AP, payroll, banking, and reporting tools 
 Experience across multiple restaurant, franchise, or hospitality platforms such as QBO, Sage Intacct, or other industry-specific ERP and accounting solutions 
 Experience in outsourced accounting, CAS, ERP consulting, restaurant technology, culinary systems, or scalable implementation and governance design 
 
        \n  Why work for Aprio:  
 Whether you are just starting out, looking to advance into management or searching for your next leadership role, Aprio offers an opportunity to grow with a future-focused, innovative firm. 
   
   
  Perks/Benefits we offer for full-time team members:  
  -  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance on the first day of employment 
  -  Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Account 
  -  401k with Profit Sharing 
  -  9+ holidays and discretionary time off structure 
  -  Parental Leave â coverage for both primary and secondary caregivers 
  -  Tuition Assistance Program and CPA support program with cash incentive upon completion 
  -  Discretionary incentive compensation based on firm, group and individual performance 
  -  Incentive compensation related to origination of new client sales 
  -  Top rated wellness program 
  -  Flexible working environment including remote and hybrid options 
   
     
  Whatâs in it for you:  
  - Working with an industry leader : Be part of a high-growth firm that is passionate for whatâs next. 
  - An awesome culture:  Thirty-one fundamental behaviors guide our culture every day ensuring we always deliver an exceptional team-member and client experience.  We call it the Aprio Way.  This shared mindset creates lasting relationships between team members and with clients. 
  - A great team:  Work with a high-energy, passionate, caring and ambitious team of professionals in a collaborative culture. 
  - Entrepreneurship : Have the freedom to innovate and bring your ideas to help us grow to become the CPA firm of choice nationally. 
  - Growth opportunities : Grow professionally in an environment that fosters continuous learning and advancement. 
  - Competitive compensation : You will be rewarded with competitive compensation, industry-leading benefits and a flexible work environment to enjoy work/life balance. 
   
   
  EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER  
 Aprio is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex; pregnancy; sexual orientation; gender identity and/or expression; age; disability; genetic information, citizenship status; military service obligations or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 
   
 Aprio, LLP and Aprio Advisory Group, LLC, operate in an alternative business structure, with Aprio Advisory Group, LLC providing non-attest tax and consulting services, and Aprio, LLP providing CPA firm services.
